headline: Trilegal, DSK Legal act on Laser Power & Infra ₹742 crore IPO
sum: Laser Power & Infra Limited has made an initial public offering of equity shares aggregating to ₹742 crore, comprising a fresh issue aggregating to ₹542 crore and offer for sale of 9,345,793 equity shares by Deepak Goel, Rakhi Goel and…
detail: Laser Power & Infra Limited has made an initial public offering of equity shares aggregating to ₹742 crore, comprising a fresh issue aggregating to ₹542 crore and offer for sale of 9,345,793 equity shares by Deepak Goel, Rakhi Goel and Devesh Goel (Promoter Selling Shareholders) aggregating to ₹200 crore. Trilegal advised Laser Power & Infra and the Promoter Selling Shareholders on this IPO. The transaction was led by Abhinav Maker (Partner), with support from Maniya Goyal (Senior Associate) and Associates Varda Saxena and K Prashant Agarwal. Abhinav Maker DSK Legal advised IIFL Capital Services Limited and ICICI Securities Limited, the book running lead managers on this IPO.
